verdict.rationale: Penpot documents first-party self-hosting via docker compose and Kubernetes (official Helm Chart, OpenShift, Rancher) in any environment you control. Its full platform source is public under MPL-2.0, and community members report running self-hosted instances successfully. missing for 10: consistent hands-on stability evidence, since some self-hosters report crashes and lag under load while others report it working fine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Penpot is the only open-source design platform that is truly deployment agnostic. Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.
Deploy with docker compose ... Use Kubernetes in its different flavors: Deploy the official Helm Chart, Deploy in Openshift, Deploy in Rancher
The full platform source (frontend, backend, exporter) is public in the same repository.
Have been self-hosting this on Docker/Portainer for several weeks for a few people. Works fine so far.
